title: Add full install acceptance

context.summary: Add an installer acceptance harness that validates dry-run install behavior and can run a live Docker smoke in a temp MINDORY_HOME.
context.background: Installer core, wizard, bootstrap, recovery and matrix checks exist. The final task ties them into an acceptance command and documents the live Docker path.

in: Dry-run acceptance validates installer CLI, repair/resume surfaces, bootstrap syntax and matrix checks.
Live mode uses a temp MINDORY_HOME and runs the MVP demo acceptance flow.
Live mode resets the stack and removes the temp home on completion.
Add acceptance command to pnpm check in dry-run mode.

acceptance_criteria: pnpm installer:acceptance runs in dry-run mode without Docker mutation.
MINDORY_INSTALL_ACCEPTANCE_LIVE=true pnpm installer:acceptance runs the Docker MVP smoke path with temp MINDORY_HOME.
Acceptance covers installer plan, repair/resume, update dry-run and uninstall/reset surfaces.
Temp install home cleanup is best-effort and scoped to the created temp path.
pnpm check includes dry-run installer acceptance.

manual_checks: Confirm live Docker mode is opt-in through MINDORY_INSTALL_ACCEPTANCE_LIVE=true.

risks: Live Docker acceptance may require cached images or network access.
Cleanup must not delete user-provided MINDORY_HOME values.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
